en.title: Is Power of 2
en.description:
Given an integer n, return 1 if n is a non-negative integer power of 2, otherwise return 0. In the example, 1=2⁰, so 1 is a power of 2.

This site adds the standard input/output protocol; it does not mean the original site's function problem had this protocol.
en.input: Input a signed 32-bit integer n (−2^31≤n≤2^31−1); the range is filled in according to the int type in the original function signature.
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for the full approach, proof, and complexity.
hints: A positive integer is a power of 2 when exactly one of its binary bits is 1.
